 LIMIT %(param_13)s) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY word_similarity(%(word_similarity_1)s, ai_search_index.value) DESC NULLS LAST, (ai_search_index.embedding <-> %(q_vec)s) ASC NULLS LAST, ai_search_index.entity_id ASC, ai_search_index.path ASC 
 LIMIT %(param_14)s), 
entity_scores AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (field_candidates.entity_id) field_candidates.entity_id AS entity_id, field_candidates.entity_title AS entity_title, max(field_candidates.fuzzy_score) OVER (PARTITION BY field_candidates.entity_id) AS best_fuzzy_score, first_value(field_candidates.value) OVER (PARTITION BY field_candidates.entity_id ORDER BY field_candidates.fuzzy_score DESC, field_candidates.path ASC) AS highlight_text, first_value(field_candidates.path) OVER (PARTITION BY field_candidates.entity_id ORDER BY field_candidates.fuzzy_score DESC, field_candidates.path ASC) AS highlight_path

FROM ai_search_index 
WHERE ai_search_index.embedding IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (ai_search_index.embedding <-> %(q_vec)s) ASC 
 LIMIT %(param_15)s),

(SELECT DISTINCT ON (semantic_candidates.entity_id) semantic_candidates.entity_id AS entity_id, semantic_candidates.entity_title AS entity_title, min(semantic_candidates.semantic_distance) OVER (PARTITION BY semantic_candidates.entity_id) AS best_semantic_distance, first_value(semantic_candidates.value) OVER (PARTITION BY semantic_candidates.entity_id ORDER BY semantic_candidates.semantic_distance ASC, semantic_candidates.path ASC) AS highlight_text, first_value(semantic_candidates.path) OVER (PARTITION BY semantic_candidates.entity_id ORDER BY semantic_candidates.semantic_distance ASC, semantic_candidates.path ASC) AS highlight_path
